# example.com as an octoDNS zone (example.com.yaml), written by DomainScope from route53.
# Keys are in octoDNS order; the SOA, the apex NS and what octoDNS cannot hold are left out (see the notes).
---
'':

    type: CAA
    value:
      flags: 0
      tag: issue
      value: amazon.com

    type: MX

        preference: 10
      - exchange: mx2.example.net.

## dnscontrol (dnsconfig.js, text/javascript;charset=utf-8, 22 written)
// example.com as DNSControl's dnsconfig.js, written by DomainScope from route53.
// Read the notes DomainScope listed, then run `dnscontrol preview` before `dnscontrol push`.
var REG_NONE = NewRegistrar("none");
var DSP_MAIN = NewDnsProvider("main"); // the name of your provider's entry in creds.json

D("example.com", REG_NONE, DnsProvider(DSP_MAIN),
    DefaultTTL(300),
    R53_ALIAS("@", "A", "d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net.", R53_ZONE("Z2FDTNDATAQYW2")),
    MX("@", 10, "mail.example.com."),
    MX("@", 20, "mx2.example.net."),
    TXT("@", "v=spf1 ip4:198.51.100.25 include:amazonses.com ~all"),
    TXT("@", ["part-one-of-a-long-value-", "part-two"]),
    CAA("@", "issue", "amazon.com"),
    CNAME("*", "example.com."),
    R53_ALIAS("api", "A", "dualstack.my-alb-1234567890.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com.", R53_ZONE("Z35SXDOTRQ7X7K"), R53_EVALUATE_TARGET_HEALTH(true)),
    R53_ALIAS("static", "A", "s3-website-us-east-1.amazonaws.com.", R53_ZONE("Z3AQBSTGFYJSTF")),
    R53_ALIAS("gw", "A", "d-abcdef1234.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com.", R53_ZONE("Z1UJRXOUMOOFQ8")),
    R53_ALIAS("www", "A", "example.com.", R53_ZONE("Z0EXAMPLEZONEID")),
    A("app", "192.0.2.21", TTL(60)),
    A("app", "192.0.2.22", TTL(60)),
    A("geo", "198.51.100.30", TTL(60)),
    A("geo", "198.51.100.31", TTL(60)),
    A("lat", "203.0.113.40", TTL(60)),
    A("ha", "203.0.113.50", TTL(60)),
    A("ha", "203.0.113.51", TTL(60)),
    A("multi", "192.0.2.61", TTL(60)),
    A("db.internal", "10.0.12.34"),
    SRV("_sip._tcp", 10, 5, 5060, "sip.example.com."),
    TXT("name\\032with\\032space", "octal — escapes in TXT"),
END);
